sku.placeholder: Made from the name if left blank

cost.description: Total unit cost — the sum of costComponents when those are used. Margin is price less this.

name.description: e.g. purchase, freight in, packaging, handling, prep labour

price.description: Price per unit at this tier

groups.description: Limit to specific groups (empty = all customers)

enabled.description: Show a live design preview on the product page.

views.description: One entry per angle/side (Front, Back, …), each with its own mockup image and zones.

baseImage.description: The mockup image for this view (the blank shirt). Single file.

zones.description: Where uploaded artwork is placed on this view.

attribute.description: Name of the file-type attribute whose upload fills this zone (e.g. "artwork").

label.description: Human label for the zone, e.g. "Chest logo".

fit.description: How the uploaded art fits the zone box.

shipsAs.description: How this ships. Empty for ordinary goods.

config.description: Shipping configuration to price this product (empty = the site default)
config.notes: Rarely needed. Say what the product is with Ships As instead of pointing it at a rate.

override.description: Quick override: free shipping or flat rate

flatRate.description: Flat rate amount (when override is flat)

quantity.description: Units of this product per box

weight.description: Weight of the empty box, if it matters

shipsAlone.description: Always ships in its own package

excludeCountries.description: Countries where this product cannot be shipped

json.label: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

excludeStates.description: States/regions where this product cannot be shipped

required.hint: Shopper must provide this attribute on THIS product before checkout. Off = optional.

enabled.description: This product is a gift card: buying it issues one.

denominations.description: Fixed values the shopper can pick, e.g. 25, 50, 100. Empty means only the product price.

expiresAfterDays.description: Days from purchase until the card expires. Empty means never — the default for purchased cards.

collectRecipient.description: Ask for a recipient name, email and message at checkout.

allowScheduledDelivery.description: Let the shopper pick a date for the card email.

permissionScope.description: POS permission the seller needs, e.g. alcohol. Matches a requirement rule’s POS permission scope. Empty with age-restricted on = age_restricted

affiliateEligible.description: Whether this product is eligible for affiliate commissions

affiliateCommission.description: Product-specific commission rate (percentage). Overrides program default. Leave empty to use program rate.

workflow.description: The product's own publishing/approval workflow — the workflow a product goes through to be approved and published into the catalog. It has nothing to do with orders: order lines are prepared by their prepStation option and fired to prep-pipeline.

workflowId.description: Workflow definition that approves/publishes this product into the catalog (not a kitchen or prep station)

defaultCourse.description: Default course/grouping (appetizer, main, dessert, drinks, etc.)

supplierSku.title: Supplier SKU
supplierSku.description: External supplier product identifier used by the server-side adapter.
